title: 蒙多·白衣高窗
description: 蒙多穿完整白色厚外衣与深色衣裤，稳站宽阔高窗走廊，紫色巨大体格与冷暖光面清楚分开。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Dr. Mundo is an enormous purple-skinned adult with an exaggerated square jaw, a small dark hair tuft, broad nose, and very heavy powerful build. Preserve his recognizable purple face and white coat motif while keeping the coat intact over a fully opaque shirt and trousers with boots. His cleaver-shaped signature tool remains safely secured in a closed side sheath, without needles, wounds, or medical horror.
art_direction.scene: He stands calmly beside a huge industrial window, arms relaxed and gaze thoughtful rather than manic, with both feet fully supported on the broad floor. A single directional beam breaks his white coat into angular wax-crayon planes. Keep the environment sparse, with one receding doorway and cool structural shadows, presenting strength through scale and posture rather than aggression.
art_direction.palette: deep purple, coat ivory, cool steel blue, warm ochre
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
